categories.name: docs
categories.evidence: Solely edits doc/i2p.md to document the behavior of -privatebroadcast over I2P.
categories.rationale: Corrects inaccurate documentation regarding persistent I2P addresses and outbound connections. As noted in the description, 'doc/i2p.md stated that persistent I2P addresses are used for making outbound and accepting inbound connections without noting the exception introduced by transaction private broadcasts, giving node operators an incomplete picture of their I2P network footprint.'
